class.name: CabinState
class.description: The state of a [VehicleServer] cabin, of the vehicle it is attached to. Owned by [CabinSystem] and handed to every registered cabin control handler, which may read and modify it. The vehicle is reached only by its [VehicleServer] handle (commands and state). A cab works three vehicles: the one it is in, the one its controls drive (an EMU's motor car) and the one carrying its pantographs. A control names its own ([enum Target]).

method.name: get_value
method.description: The current value of the control, or [param default] when it has none.

method.name: is_pressed
method.description: Whether a push control ends up pressed by the manipulation: held, or toggled to the given value - a toggle without one (e.g. from the console) flips its current position.

method.name: send_vehicle_command
method.description: A command of a control, to its [param target].

method.name: set_value
method.description: Sets the current value of the control; [signal CabinSystem.control_changed] is emitted when it changes.

method.name: vehicle_component
method.description: One component of a [param target] - what a cab logic reads on every step: the dump is composed anew for each read in a step.

method.name: vehicle_of
method.description: The vehicle of a [param target] of the cab in [param occupied].

method.name: vehicle_state_value
method.description: One named value of a [param target]'s state - what a control driven by a state's name reads.

members.member: Whether the dashboard light is lit. Written only by [method CabinSystem.cabin_set_dashboard_light_enabled].
